testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-021 SAN-011 SAN-020 SAN-023 EDG-017 SAN-002 SAN-007 SAN-001: All cart entry points open the combined page

scenario.summary: As a created Sales Rep reached through Shop As, Add to Cart keeps the user on the PDP and updates the header count; the Header Cart, PDP Redeem Now, the PLP cart entry and direct /cart and /checkout all open the same combined page; no native cart page; the cart survives logging out and in.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter quantity 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Add to Cart; check the user stays on the PDP and the Header cart count shows 1 (SAN-007, SAN-001, SAN-002)
Open the PLP; check product tiles load without prices (SAN-001)
Click Cart in the Header; note URL, heading and sections; check the Order Summary lists @product.variant1Sku with quantity 1 (SAN-011, SAN-007, SAN-021 steps 1-2)
Check there is no separate native cart page and no 'Proceed to Checkout' step (SAN-011)
Browser Back; check the PDP opens (SAN-002)
On the PDP enter 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Redeem Now; compare URL, heading and sections with the Header page (SAN-021 steps 3-4)
Open the PLP and use its cart entry; compare URL, heading and sections (SAN-020, SAN-021 steps 5-6)
Open /cart and then /checkout directly; compare with the Header page and check for native cart elements (SAN-023, EDG-017)

Log out from the Header (ends the Shop As impersonation; the tester is back in the own Admin session), then in Web Admin Users choose Shop As on the same user (@user.userName) again; open the Header Cart and check the line is still there (SAN-001 step 5, adapted to Shop As)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep user and its allotment are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart lines added by Add to Cart and Redeem Now
Logout ends the Shop As impersonation; Shop As on the same user again
assertions: Add to Cart keeps the user on the PDP and the Header cart count reflects the added item
Header Cart, PDP Redeem Now, PLP cart entry, /cart and /checkout open the same combined page: same URL, heading and sections
The combined page URL is /checkout (SAN-002; open in analysis Q12)
No native cart page, subtotal, Estimate Shipping or 'Proceed to Checkout' step is shown
Browser Back from the combined page returns to the PDP
After Logout (end of Shop As) and Shop As on the same user again the cart line is still shown on the combined page
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-021, SAN-011, SAN-020, SAN-023, EDG-017, SAN-002, SAN-007, SAN-001 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it
SAN-021 precondition 'BNJM store published' is checked through the product key (publish state PRODUCTION and a published product entity on the store)

SAN-001 step 5 'log out and log back in' becomes Logout (which ends Shop As) and Shop As on the same created user again, since created users never sign in with a password. Decision 2026-11-27 (analysis section 11): Logout during Shop As ends the impersonation, not the Admin's session; after Logout the tester is back in the own Admin session
Heading text is not compared to a fixed value here (SAN-024 only, BMP-500)
